defined_through: Almond panel, Environment workspace (EnvironmentWorkspace actions define_room / assign / run), live in Rhino 8

rooms.Garden pavilion: outdoor (test pavilion added for the open-space path)

notes: Room Garden pavilion is an open space (66 % open): it is assessed as semi-outdoor comfort (air at outdoor temperature, sun and sky on the occupants); no heating or cooling loads.
Room Landing opens into other parts of the building (5 m2: W 5 m2). Those openings are treated as adiabatic, with no air exchange; for open-plan spaces define one room.
Room Bedroom: 1.0 m2 of its boundary has no element within 0.35 m (gaps in the model, or small openings); treated as closed.
Room Study opens into other parts of the building (20 m2: S 20 m2). Those openings are treated as adiabatic, with no air exchange; for open-plan spaces define one room.
Room Hall and dining opens into other parts of the building (6 m2: up 6 m2). Those openings are treated as adiabatic, with no air exchange; for open-plan spaces define one room.

Room Living: 4.3 m2 of its boundary has no element within 0.35 m (gaps in the model, or small openings); treated as closed. Room Living opens into other parts of the building (21 m2: N 21 m2). Those openings are treated as adiabatic, with no air exchange; for open-plan spaces define one room.
No mechanical cooling: rooms run free in warm weather.

tropical_synthetic.weather: SYNTHETIC tropical year at 1.35 N (tests/env_weather.py) - not Singapore data
tropical_synthetic.settings: cooling to room set-points, no heat recovery, no window ventilation

retv.note: Indicative: formulas from the BCA Code on Envelope Thermal Performance; CF derived by Almond from the weather file; SC = g / 0.87 from the glazing g-value over the whole window, with no credit for external shading devices (conservative). Not a BCA Green Mark assessment.

tropical_singapore.weather: Singapore-Changi Intl AP 486980, TMYx 2011-2025 (climate.onebuilding.org; downloaded by the user, not redistributed)
tropical_singapore.settings: cooling to room set-points (air temperature), no heat recovery, no window ventilation; same as tropical_synthetic
tropical_singapore.note: Cooling holds the air at the set-point; operative temperature includes the warmer glass and wall surfaces, so hours above 26 degC operative are close to all occupied hours in cooled rooms. Hours above 28 degC are reported instead.

retv.note: Indicative: formulas from the BCA Code on Envelope Thermal Performance; CF derived by Almond from the weather file; SC = g / 0.87 from the glazing g-value over the whole window, with no credit for external shading devices (conservative). Not a BCA Green Mark assessment.
